post_fix_attempts.result: Availability and current-date letters of credit were recovered; unsupported commitment was safely suppressed.

post_fix_attempts.purpose: Validate explicitly scaled Credit Agreement limit extraction and facility reconciliation.
post_fix_attempts.result: The $400.0m commitment reconciled to $368.2m availability plus $31.8m letters of credit within the allowed rounding tolerance.

first_run_defects.observed: The generic parser assigned a $350.0m private-shelf Note Agreement amount to the Credit Agreement commitment.
first_run_defects.shared_root_cause: Facility extraction accepted nearby debt-note amounts without requiring an instrument-bound label and scale.
first_run_defects.risk: Liquidity and refinancing analysis could use a commitment from the wrong instrument.

first_run_defects.observed: The parser selected the prior-date $37.5m letters-of-credit amount instead of the March 31, 2026 amount of $31.8m.
first_run_defects.shared_root_cause: A sentence using paired amounts and dates with the word respectively was not mapped by date.
first_run_defects.risk: A point-in-time liquidity calculation could combine values from different reporting dates.

first_run_defects.observed: The March 31, 2026 disclosed availability of $368.2m was not extracted.
first_run_defects.shared_root_cause: The shared parser did not recognize a dated availability phrase in the facility note.
first_run_defects.risk: The system could materially understate observable liquidity.

first_run_defects.observed: Receivables and DSO were available, but absent DIO, DPO, and CCC fields were not explicitly classified.
first_run_defects.shared_root_cause: The shared working-capital module did not distinguish partial metric coverage from a complete cash-conversion cycle.
first_run_defects.risk: A service business could appear to have complete working-capital analysis when inventory metrics were unavailable or not applicable.

changes: Map respectively-linked amount/date pairs to the requested reporting date.
Require dated and instrument-bound facility disclosures.
Prefer explicitly scaled Credit Agreement limit tables over generic nearby amounts.
Reconcile commitment to availability and known reductions, with an automatic Hard Stop for an impossible material mismatch.
Classify working-capital component coverage without treating absent metrics as zero.
Expose available and missing working-capital components in the underwriting limitations.
Require analyst classification of unavailable components as NOT_APPLICABLE or MISSING before final underwriting.
Verify immutable file sets and SHA256 hashes for preserved runs.
Write post-fix output to a separate directory and refuse overwrite.

decision_safety.note: The final warning count increased from 20 to 21 because incomplete working-capital coverage is now disclosed explicitly. This is a safety improvement, not a regression.
